calibration_sources: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Specification 2025-03-26+ Streamable HTTP Transport (Mcp-Session-Id & Last-Event-ID Resumability)
Google / Linux Foundation Agent2Agent (A2A) Protocol Specification (/.well-known/agent.json, Task Lifecycle & Artifact Streaming)
Enterprise Multi-Agent Tool-Selection Accuracy vs. Schema Context Bloat Empirical Studies

workload.enterprise_scenario: Enterprise Cross-Departmental Workflow (ERP + CRM + GitHub + Data Warehouse: 240 total tools across 6 domain teams, 100,000 tasks/month)
workload.protocol_distinction: Anthropic MCP = Vertical Agent-to-Tool/Resource JSON-RPC 2.0 execution; Google/LF A2A = Horizontal Agent-to-Agent opaque task delegation via Agent Cards & async task state machine
workload.transport_evolution: Legacy HTTP+SSE required a persistent GET /sse stream paired with POST /messages; Streamable HTTP unifies everything into POST/GET /mcp with stateless/resumable Mcp-Session-Id

tiers.name: Tier 1: 本地 Stdio 子进程 MCP + 240 个工具全量注入单个 Agent (每轮浪费 68K Tokens ✕)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Local Stdio Subprocess MCP + Flat 240-Tool Injection into Single Agent (68K Tokens/Turn Bloat)
tiers.recommended_for: Single-user desktop IDE plugins (Claude Desktop / VS Code local tools); impossible for multi-tenant cloud or >30 tools.

tiers.name: Tier 2: 旧版 MCP HTTP+SSE 双端点长连接 + 单体大 Agent (K8s 滚动升级断连率 42.5% ✕)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Legacy MCP HTTP+SSE Dual-Endpoint (2024-11-05) + Monolithic Agent (42.5% Drop Rate on K8s Scale)
tiers.recommended_for: Legacy 2024 MCP prototypes; dual-channel GET /sse + POST /messages breaks serverless scale-to-zero and stateless L7 load balancers.

tiers.name: Tier 3: 新一代 MCP Streamable HTTP (单 /mcp 端点 + Mcp-Session-Id 断点续传 + 动态按需挂载工具)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: Modern MCP Streamable HTTP (Single /mcp Endpoint + Mcp-Session-Id Resume + Dynamic Tool Search)
tiers.recommended_for: Single-domain cloud Agent platforms exposing remote MCP tool servers behind standard stateless L7 API gateways.

tiers.name: Tier 4: A2A 水平智能体联邦 (Agent Card 异步任务委派) + MCP 垂直工具网关双层架构
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: Dual-Layer Federated Mesh: A2A Horizontal Agent Delegation + MCP Vertical Streamable HTTP Gateways
tiers.recommended_for: Enterprise multi-department AI ecosystems: Orchestrator discovers 6 domain agents via A2A Cards while each domain agent calls its 40 internal tools via MCP.
